plain letters in any case are one name
a letter whose capital is two letters keeps itself: straße is not STRASSE
nor is ß the capital sharp s
a ligature keeps itself: ﬁle is not FILE
a dotless i is not an I
a long s is not an S
a dotted capital I is not an i with a dot above, which its full lower case is
the Kelvin sign is not a k
a final sigma and a medial one are one letter
a small letter with a subscript iota is its one-letter capital
and not the two letters its full capital is
a letter beyond the basic plane compares with its capital
what has no case is itself
a small letter orders as its capital, before a mark
